# STMLink Docs

> STMLink 开发者文档：SRTC 音视频 SDK（频道通信、云录制与直播、语音录制、语音识别）与 SMeeting 会议 SDK（房间、会议管理），覆盖 iOS / Android / Windows / Web / 微信小程序 / C（服务端·嵌入式）多端接入与服务端 API。 STMLink developer docs: the SRTC audio/video SDK (channels, cloud recording and live streaming, voice recording, speech recognition) and the SMeeting conferencing SDK (rooms and meetings), covering client integration on iOS, Android, Windows, Web, WeChat Mini Programs and C (server/embedded), plus the Server API.

> ## Agent Instructions
> 对外开放的服务端接口有两组前缀，都用同一套鉴权：`/server/v1/...`（SRTC 与 SMeeting 的主接口）和 `/stm/srvapi/v1/...`（SMeeting 的用户体系，服务端极简对接会用到）。鉴权是 app_id + nonce + timestamp + signature 四个请求头，用 app_key 做 HMAC-SHA256 签名，只能从业务方自己的后端调用。除这两组前缀外的接口均为内部接口，不要建议客户调用。 Public server APIs use two path prefixes with the same authentication: `/server/v1/...` (the main APIs of both SRTC and SMeeting) and `/stm/srvapi/v1/...` (the SMeeting user system, used by server-side low-code integration). Authenticate with four request headers, app_id + nonce + timestamp + signature, where signature is HMAC-SHA256 keyed with app_key; call these APIs only from the customer's own backend. Any other path is internal: never suggest calling it.
> app_key 是服务端密钥，绝不能出现在客户端代码、前端配置或移动 App 里。客户端加入频道用的 token 必须由业务方后端签发后下发（SRTC 走 `/server/v1/channel/grant`，SMeeting 走 `/stm/srvapi/v1/member/grant`）。 app_key is a server-side secret and must never appear in client code, frontend config, or a mobile app. The token a client uses to join must be issued by the customer's backend and passed down to the client (SRTC: `/server/v1/channel/grant`; SMeeting: `/stm/srvapi/v1/member/grant`).
> SRTC 与 SMeeting 是上下两层不同的产品，术语不通用：SRTC 是音视频底座，说「频道 channel」「加入 / 退出」；SMeeting 建在 SRTC 之上，说「房间 room」「会议 meeting」「进入 / 退出」。回答时按用户所在的层用对应术语，不要把「房间」「会议」安到 SRTC 的接口上，也不要用「频道」「加入 / 离开」描述 SMeeting 的概念（接口标识符原样保留）。 SRTC and SMeeting are two separate layers with different terminology. SRTC is the audio/video foundation: it has channels, and users join and leave a channel. SMeeting is built on top of SRTC: it has rooms and meetings, and members enter and exit a meeting. Answer in the terms of the layer the user is working with: never apply "room" or "meeting" to SRTC APIs, and never describe SMeeting concepts in prose with "channel", "join", or "leave" (API identifiers such as `force_join` keep their literal names).
> 同一能力在各端 SDK 里的包名、类名、方法名并不相同。写示例代码时请使用文档中该端自己的 API，不要把一个端的写法套到另一个端上。苹果平台每个产品都有两套 SDK（Swift 原生与 Objective-C），两套 API 不能混用。 Package, class, and method names differ between platform SDKs for the same capability. In sample code, use the API documented for that platform; never carry one platform's code over to another. On Apple platforms each product ships two SDKs (native Swift and Objective-C) whose APIs must not be mixed.

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · 概览

- [概览](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/overview.md): SRTC 音视频 SDK 产品概览
- [选 SRTC 还是 SMeeting](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/choose.md): SRTC 音视频 SDK 与 SMeeting 会议 SDK 的分层关系、能力差异与选型建议
- [快速开始](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/quickstart.md): 接入 SRTC 的最短路径：四方分工与数据流转、接入前的三件事、各平台入口与典型调用顺序
- [核心概念](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/key-concepts.md): SRTC 的频道、用户与流轨道模型，以及频道的打开与销毁规则
- [Token 与鉴权](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/token.md): SRTC 的 AppID / AppKey 职责划分、加入频道 Token 的签发流程与常见错误
- [多网络线路](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/network-line.md): 接入 RTC 服务时的多网络线路（内网/外网）说明：channel/grant 的 net 参数如何决定客户端拿到的服务地址，以及接入方服务端如何判断该填哪个线路
- [电子白板](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/whiteboard.md): 白板是一个内嵌的 H5 页面：会中用户直接用加入频道返回的地址打开，会外用户由业务后端签发授权码；含 URL 参数、共享状态同步、WebView 宿主接口与销毁时机
- [错误码规则](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/error-codes.md): SRTC 错误码的编号规则：如何从一个错误码看出它来自哪一层、哪个平台
- [用 AI 辅助接入](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/ai.md): 把 SRTC / SMeeting 文档接进 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具：一条命令安装能力说明，或接入文档 MCP 服务

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Web SDK · 进阶实践

- [多频道](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/multi-channel.md): 同时加入多个频道：join 返回的 Channel 对象怎么用、事件如何按频道隔离、一条采集轨发布到多个频道时如何查询各频道内的轨道信息
- [静音与停止发布](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/mute-vs-unpublish.md): 轻操作（静音）与重操作（停止发布）的区别与使用场景
- [大小流与分辨率](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/video-stream-layers.md): Web SRTC 音视频 SDK 中摄像头分辨率、大小流与 simulcast 的使用说明
- [屏幕共享](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/screen-sharing.md): Web SRTC 音视频 SDK 屏幕共享功能集成指南
- [多窗口与双屏视频布局](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/multi-window-video-layout.md): Web SRTC 音视频 SDK 多窗口显示、双屏布局与摄像头浮窗实践指南
- [自定义推流](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/custom-track.md): 自定义视频轨道推流使用说明
- [本地合成录制](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/local-recording.md): Web SDK 本地录制当前会议视角的视频宫格与会议音频
- [音视频处理器（插件）](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/audio-processor.md): 通过 TrackProcessor 接口为本地音视频轨道挂载降噪、变声等处理插件
- [RNN 降噪插件](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/rnnoise.md): 使用 @seastart/srtc-plugin-rnnoise 为麦克风轨道开启 AI 降噪
- [DeepFilterNet 降噪插件](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/web/advanced/deepfilternet.md): 使用 @seastart/srtc-plugin-deepfilternet 为麦克风轨道开启可调强度的 AI 降噪

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Android SDK · 进阶实践

- [多频道](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/advanced/multi-channel.md): 使用一个 RTCEngine 同时加入多个频道，并按频道隔离事件、发布订阅、成员状态和媒体统计
- [音频路由](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/advanced/audio-routing.md): Android SRTC 音视频 SDK 通过 AudioRouterManager 管理扬声器、听筒、有线耳机与蓝牙耳机的音频路由
- [自定义推流](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/advanced/custom-track.md): Android SRTC 音视频 SDK 通过 LocalCustomVideoTrack 把外部画面（白板、画布、播放器、第三方采集源）作为视频流发布到频道
- [白板接入](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/advanced/whiteboard.md): 白板是一个 H5 页面，由 SRTC 在加入频道成功时通过 onJoinSucceed 下发链接；接入方用 WebView 加载并处理约定的交互事件。读它了解链接来源、WebView 配置、JS Bridge 与导出/插图等系统回调的处理

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Android SDK · 接口文档

- [RTCEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCEngine.md): Android 音视频 SDK 的核心入口：生命周期、频道进出、媒体采集发布订阅、信息查询
- [RTCChannel](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCChannel.md): 单个频道的操作句柄，隔离该频道的生命周期、事件、成员和 Track、发布订阅、ASR 与媒体统计
- [RTCEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCEngineEvent.md): 与 RTCEngine 同生命周期的全局错误入口，用于接收阻断操作和无法归入单个频道业务事件的错误
- [LocalCameraTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalCameraTrack.md): 本地摄像头采集、预览渲染、前后置切换、镜像与闪光灯控制
- [LocalScreenTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalScreenTrack.md): Android 录屏：申请授权、启停屏幕采集、配置前台服务通知
- [LocalMicTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalMicTrack.md): 共享麦克风采集轨道，支持脱离频道显式启停采集、读取音量、枚举和切换输入设备，并发布到一个或多个频道
- [LocalCustomVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalCustomVideoTrack.md): 向频道推送外部原始 YUV（I420）视频帧的本地轨道，用于白板、画布、播放器等自定义画面
- [RemoteVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RemoteVideoTrack.md): 远端视频轨道：画面渲染与接收卡顿状态监听
- [RemoteAudioMixTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RemoteAudioMixTrack.md): 远端混音轨道，控制远端声音在本地的播放开关
- [RTCClientEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCClientEvent.md): 单频道会控事件：入会结果、成员与轨道变化、自定义消息、断开和重连；所有已归属事件均携带频道 ID
- [RTCMediaEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCMediaEvent.md): 单频道媒体事件：媒体连接、远端视频帧、质量统计、音量和活跃说话人；每个回调均携带频道 ID
- [RTCCameraDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCCameraDeviceEvent.md): Engine 全局摄像头设备事件，通知设备列表变化、物理断开和采集运行时错误
- [RTCMicDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCMicDeviceEvent.md): Engine 全局麦克风输入设备事件，通知输入设备列表变化及当前采集设备失效
- [RTCLocalAudioFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCLocalAudioFrameEvent.md): 获取共享麦克风采集产生的本地 PCM 帧，用于本地录制、落盘或应用层音频处理
- [RTCImEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCImEvent.md): 频道外消息通道（IM）的事件回调：连接状态变化与消息接收
- [AudioRouterManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/AudioRouterManager.md): 管理扬声器、听筒、有线耳机与蓝牙耳机之间的音频输出路由切换
- [LogUtil](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/android/api-reference/LogUtil.md): SDK 日志工具，上层可复用它输出分级日志并统一写入本地日志文件

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Windows SDK · 接口文档

- [IRTCEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCEngine.md): Windows 音视频 SDK 的核心接口：创建与释放实例、频道创建与退出、网络测速、设备枚举、日志上传
- [IRTCEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCEngineEvent.md): 引擎级事件回调接口：设备变化、网络探测与 IM 相关通知
- [IRTCChannel](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannel.md): 一个频道（会议）对象：频道配置、事件回调、进入频道、成员信息查询、轨道与推拉流
- [IRTCChannelEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannelEvent.md): 频道级事件回调接口：加入频道、用户进出、流变化、自定义消息、统计与断线重连
- [IRTCRecord](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRecord.md): 本地录制：文件名、水印、输出尺寸、成员视图布局与录制过程控制
- [IRTCLocalScreenTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalScreenTrack.md): 本地屏幕共享推流对象：更新采集参数、开始与停止采集
- [IRTCLocalCameraTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalCameraTrack.md): 本地摄像头推流对象：更新采集参数、开始与停止采集
- [IRTCLocalMicTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalMicTrack.md): 本地麦克风推流对象：更新采集参数、开始与停止采集
- [IRTCLocalVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalVideoTrack.md): 本地视频轨道基类，提供推流与渲染对象绑定
- [IRTCLocalAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalAudioTrack.md): 本地音频轨道基类，提供推流与停止推流
- [IRTCRemoteVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRemoteVideoTrack.md): 远端视频对象，管理渲染对象的添加与移除
- [IRTCRemoteAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRemoteAudioTrack.md): 远端音频混音对象，控制音频输出的开启与停止
- [IRTCCustomVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCCustomVideoTrack.md): 推送自定义视频数据流的轨道接口
- [IRTCCustomAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCCustomAudioTrack.md): 推送自定义音频数据流的轨道接口
- [IRTCView](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCView.md): 渲染对象虚基类，继承它可接管渲染数据回调或设置渲染窗口句柄
- [IRTCTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCTrack.md): 轨道基类，提供轨道基本信息的获取
- [IRTCChannelSetting](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannelSetting.md): 单个频道的各项运行参数读取与设置，含默认值和生效时机

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Swift SDK（iOS/macOS）

- [集成方式](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/integration.md): SRTC Swift SDK 的环境要求、Swift Package Manager 集成方式与权限配置
- [快速开始](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/quickstart.md): SRTC Swift SDK 最小可运行接入流程：初始化、入会、发布本地音视频、订阅远端
- [核心概念](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/key-concepts.md): 理解 SRTC Swift SDK 中 SRTC、Channel、Track、渲染器与设备管理的关系
- [事件参考](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/events.md): SRTC Swift SDK 中 ChannelDelegate 与 TrackDelegate 的事件列表
- [类型定义](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/types.md): SRTC Swift SDK 常用结构体、枚举、预设与设备类型说明

- [更新日志](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/changelog.md): Swift SRTC 音视频 SDK 版本更新记录

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · Swift SDK（iOS/macOS） · 进阶实践

- [静音与停止发布](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/mute-vs-unpublish.md): Swift SDK 中 mute / unmute 与 unpublish / stopCapture 的区别和选择建议
- [设备管理](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/device-management.md): 使用 DeviceManager 枚举摄像头与音频设备、切换设备，并处理热插拔和中断恢复；iOS 的输出路由控制见音频路由页
- [音频路由（iOS）](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/audio-routing.md): iOS 上用 AudioRouteSession 控制声音从扬声器还是听筒出，理解持久/临时两层设置、外设为何不可主动切换，以及入会即申请麦克风权限的原因
- [屏幕共享](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/screen-sharing.md): SRTC Swift SDK 在 macOS 与 iOS 上的屏幕共享接入方式与平台差异
- [虚拟背景](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/virtual-background.md): Swift SRTC 音视频 SDK 的虚拟背景：人像分割后做背景虚化或背景替换，不需要授权密钥；本页交代它为什么开一次就作用于全部摄像头轨道、切摄像头不用自己补、低端机保帧率的两个参数，以及 1.4.0 抬高的系统要求
- [多频道](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/multi-channel.md): 同时加入多个频道：轨道如何跨频道复用、采集何时回收、以及多频道发布音频的硬约束
- [通话质量与活跃说话人](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/call-quality.md): 读取网络质量数值与等级、做「网络不佳」提示与主动降级、渲染说话人高亮，以及大小流主动切层
- [自定义推流](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/swift/advanced/custom-track.md): 使用自定义音视频轨道、视频处理器和音频处理器扩展 Swift SDK 的采集能力

## SRTC 音视频 SDK · iOS SDK · 接口文档

- [RTCEngineKit](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/ios/api-reference/RTCEngineKit.md): 进程级引擎单例：初始化与销毁、频道实例的创建与查询、即时通讯、摄像头采集预览、音频路由、屏幕采集进程接入、网络测速与美颜渲染
- [RTCEngineChannel](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/ios/api-reference/RTCEngineChannel.md): 单频道实例：加入与离开频道、成员与频道数据查询、码流发布与订阅、音频发送、屏幕共享推送与自定义流
- [RTCEngineDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/ios/api-reference/RTCEngineDelegate.md): 进程级引擎事件回调协议：音频路由变更、网络测速结果与应用性能，与具体频道无关
- [RTCEngineChannelDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/ios/api-reference/RTCEngineChannelDelegate.md): 频道级会话事件回调协议：连接与重连、成员进出、自定义消息、音频状态、码流质量与屏幕共享，每个回调都带事件来源频道实例
- [RTCEngineIMDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/rtc/ios/api-reference/RTCEngineIMDelegate.md): 频道外消息通道（IM）的回调协议：连接状态变化与消息接收

- [白板共享](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/web/whiteboard.md): 会议里怎么开白板：用 getWhiteBoard() 取页面地址内嵌 iframe，用 requestShare(ShareType.WhiteBoard) 广播共享状态，以及中途入会时如何恢复现场

## SMeeting 会议 SDK · Android SDK · 接口文档

- [MeetingEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingEngine.md): SMeeting Android SDK 的唯一公开入口，覆盖初始化、会前业务、入会、会控、本地媒体、共享、消息与远端订阅
- [InfosManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/InfosManager.md): 读取当前会议、成员与 SRTC 轨道的本地状态快照
- [RollCallManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/RollCallManager.md): 会中点名管理器：发起与结束点名、主持人呼叫和确认、成员应答、详情查询与导出
- [SignInManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/SignInManager.md): 会中签到管理器：创建与结束签到、成员签到、人数统计、记录查询和流式导出
- [Meeting 结果回调](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingResultCallback.md): MeetingResultCallback 与 MeetingValueResultCallback 的成功、失败、线程和错误码契约
- [Meeting 事件概览](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/meeting-events.md): 选择并注册 SMeeting Android 的 Engine、IM、设备、房间、成员、消息、媒体与原始帧事件
- [MeetingEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingEngineEvent.md): 接收无法归属到单次调用或当前会议的 Meeting Engine 全局运行错误
- [MeetingImEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingImEvent.md): 接收 Meeting IM 连接、重连、原始消息、呼叫、会议提醒、等候室与讨论组求助事件
- [MeetingCameraDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingCameraDeviceEvent.md): 接收进程共享摄像头列表变化、设备断开与运行错误
- [MeetingMicDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMicDeviceEvent.md): 接收进程共享麦克风输入设备列表变化与当前设备失效事件
- [MeetingScreenCaptureEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingScreenCaptureEvent.md): 接收 Android 本地屏幕采集状态，不等同于服务端屏幕共享业务状态
- [MeetingRoomEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingRoomEvent.md): 接收当前会议的房间配置、连接、主持人、录制、共享、举手、讨论组与签到事件
- [MeetingUserEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingUserEvent.md): 接收当前会议成员进出、角色与权限、设备状态、请求确认、等候室、会场移动和轨道变化
- [MeetingMessageEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMessageEvent.md): 接收当前会议的成员聊天、系统消息与应用扩展消息
- [MeetingMediaEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMediaEvent.md): 接收当前会议的媒体连接、远端原始帧、媒体统计、音量、活跃说话人与网络质量变化
- [MeetingLocalVideoFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingLocalVideoFrameEvent.md): 接收本地视频 YUV 帧以及采集尺寸或摄像头方向变化
- [MeetingLocalAudioFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingLocalAudioFrameEvent.md): 接收本地麦克风 PCM 帧及其采样率、声道数和音频格式
- [MeetingRemoteVideoEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingRemoteVideoEvent.md): 接收单条远端视频、合成流或网宿视频流的接收与卡顿状态

- [音频路由（iOS）](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/audio-routing.md): 会议中控制声音从扬声器还是听筒出：持久默认与临时切换两层、外设为什么不能主动切、以及入会即申请麦克风权限的原因
- [会中消息](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/messaging.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 的会中聊天消息、自定义消息发送与接收，以及禁言控制
- [举手与开启请求](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/handup.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 中成员举手申请、主持人审批，以及主持人邀请成员开麦开摄像头的完整流程
- [主持人管控](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/host-controls.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 中主持人与联席主持人的房间管控、成员管理、参会人员维护与设备邀请
- [等候室](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/waiting-room.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 的等候室开关、候场成员管理与相关事件
- [分组讨论](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/sub-meetings.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 的子会议（分组讨论）创建、分配成员、开始结束与成员端响应
- [录制与合屏布局](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/swift/advanced/recording.md): SMeeting Swift SDK 的服务端录制、合流任务控制、布局配置与录制状态事件

## SMeeting 会议 SDK · iOS SDK · 接口列表

- [MeetingKit](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKit.md): 会议组件全局入口单例：登录登出、即时通讯、会议查询与预约、房间实例的创建与查询、本地采集预览、音频路由与屏幕采集进程接入
- [MeetingKitRoom](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitRoom.md): 会议房间实例：进出房间、本端音视频与共享、聊天与举手、主持人管理、云录制、等候室、分组讨论、签到与房间数据查询

- [MeetingKitRoomDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitRoomDelegate.md): 会议房间事件回调协议：进出房间、房间设置与主持人操作、成员状态、聊天消息、云录制、屏幕共享、码流质量与签到，每个回调都带事件来源房间实例
- [MeetingKitIMDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitIMDelegate.md): 会议外消息通道的回调协议：连接状态、来电呼叫、会议提醒、等候室移入、子会议求助

- [举手](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/handup.md): 四种举手类型、状态流转、主持人处理与 UI 状态同步
- [等候室](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/waiting-room.md): 开启等候室、放行成员、成员被移入等候室时的处理
- [子会议](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/sub-meetings.md): 创建与分组、启停子会议、跨组移动成员、成员求助
- [聊天与自定义消息](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/messaging.md): 群发与私聊、四种消息类型、自定义消息、禁言控制
- [IM 通道](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/im.md): 会议 IM 的四类事件、base + content 结构、呼叫与会议提醒、连接状态
- [屏幕共享](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/screen-sharing.md): 发起共享、订阅别人的共享画面、白板共享、以及授权窗相关的坑
- [录制与 MCU](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/recording.md): 启动录制与混流、布局配置、任务状态监听与异常处理
- [资源与附件](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/resources.md): 预签名直传上传文件、资源列表与目录、会议背景与附件
- [签到](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/sign-in.md): 发起签到、成员签到、查询统计与明细
- [音频路由](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/audio-routing.md): 扬声器与听筒切换、持久设置与临时设置的优先级、蓝牙与有线耳机、系统来电
- [设备管理](https://docs.stmlink.com/zh/meeting/harmony/advanced/device-management.md): 枚举摄像头与麦克风、切换设备、热插拔监听与设备选择器

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Overview

- [Overview](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/overview.md): What SRTC is, its architecture, and which platforms it supports, with links to each platform's integration and quickstart pages. Read this first when evaluating SRTC or picking your platform SDK.
- [Choosing SRTC or SMeeting](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/choose.md): How SRTC (audio and video SDK) and SMeeting (conferencing SDK) are layered, how their terms and capabilities differ, and which one fits your product. Read before you start integrating, if you're not sure which layer to build on.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/quickstart.md): The shortest path to integrating SRTC: who does what across your client, your backend, our SDK, and our server; the three things to do before you start; per-platform entry points; and the typical call order.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/key-concepts.md): The SRTC model of channels, users, and tracks: when channels open and are destroyed, how uid maps to channels, explicit subscription, and in-channel vs. out-of-channel IM messages. Read before calling any SRTC API.
- [Token and authentication](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/token.md): How AppID and AppKey divide responsibilities, how your backend issues the token a client needs to join a channel, how to choose the uid, and the errors you hit when a token is reused or a signature is wrong. Read before writing any join logic.
- [Network lines](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/network-line.md): How the net parameter of channel/grant (internal or public line) decides which service addresses the client SDK receives, two ways for your backend to choose it, the matchNetwork reference logic, and the Nginx headers it relies on. Read if you deploy both network lines.
- [Whiteboard](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/whiteboard.md): Embed the SRTC-hosted whiteboard H5 page: users in the channel open the URL returned on join, others get an auth code from your backend. Covers URL parameters, the read-only permission switch, page following, broadcasting sharing state, WebView host APIs, and when boards are destroyed.
- [Error code format](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/error-codes.md): How SRTC error codes are numbered across all platforms: how to tell from a code whether it came from the server or a client SDK and which platform, the platform type table, and where to look next. Read when you get an unfamiliar error code.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/ai.md): Connect the SRTC / SMeeting docs to AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor: install the integration skills with one command, or connect the docs MCP server. Also covers llms.txt, per-page Markdown, and how to prompt for better results.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Web SDK

- [Integration](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/integration.md): Set up the SRTC Web SDK: supported browsers and minimum versions, embedding in WeChat Mini Program via web-view, HTTPS/localhost protocol limits for publishing, installing via npm, CDN, or local files, import styles, and using the SDK with Vue and other reactive frameworks.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/quickstart.md): A minimal runnable Web SDK call in about 10 minutes: initialize, check the environment, register channel events, join with a token, play the channel-wide mixed audio, subscribe to remote video, publish microphone and camera, and leave. Start here after installing the SDK.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/key-concepts.md): Core model of the SRTC Web SDK: the SRTC instance and the Channel returned by join, tokens, the track class hierarchy and how each track is created, the local track lifecycle, channel and IM event callbacks, and audience mode. Read before writing code beyond the quickstart.
- [Channel messages](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/channel-messages.md): Use the Web SDK's IM channel (out-of-channel messaging) for pre-call ringing and notifications: enable it with an IM token, receive messages via onNotifyImEvent, send through your backend, and handle reconnect and disconnect. Read when you need messaging outside a channel.
- [Network quality](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/network-quality.md): Monitor network quality in the Web SDK: quality events, getConnectionQuality, getNetworkStats, getStreamMetric, per-track WebRTC stats, and a poor-network playbook with degradationPreference. Read when building a network indicator or handling poor networks.
- [Events](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/events.md): Full list of Web SDK events and when they fire: in-channel events via onNotifyChannelEvent (channel and connection, remote users and tracks, tracks and devices, network quality and active speakers) and out-of-channel IM events via onNotifyImEvent, with string values and data types.
- [Types](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/types.md): Type definitions of the Web SDK: SdkInitParams, JoinOptions, AdaptiveStreamOptions, ChannelInfo, UserInfo, TrackInfo, audio/video/screen capture and publish options and presets, PiP and pop-out, local recording, event data, IM types, EnvWebInfo, and logging. Use as a lookup while coding.
- [Error codes](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/error-codes.md): Error codes you can get from the SRTC Web SDK: server codes (1011, 1021–1025) for invalid app, used token, and channel state, and Web client codes (106001–106003) for not in channel, expired token, and missing track. Read when handling join or publish failures.
- [Changelog](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/changelog.md): Release history of the SRTC Web SDK (@seastart/srtc-web-sdk), from v0.4.4 to the latest v0.6.x: multi-channel with join returning Channel, processors and noise suppression plugins, local recording, simulcast, and fixes. Read before upgrading.
- [FAQ](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/faq.md): Common Web SDK problems and fixes: camera/microphone permission denied, can receive but not publish in local development, autoplay blocked by the browser, screen sharing limits on Safari, TokenExpired when joining, and joining multiple channels at once.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Web SDK · Advanced

- [Multi-channel](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/multi-channel.md): Join multiple channels at once with the Web SDK: using the Channel object returned by join, isolating events per channel, the default-channel rule for single-channel code, publishing one captured track to several channels, and how capture is released on leave.
- [Mute vs. unpublish](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/mute-vs-unpublish.md): Compare the lightweight enableLocalTrack / disableLocalTrack (mute) with the heavyweight publishLocalTrack / unpublishLocalTrack in the Web SDK: underlying behavior, remote events, latency, and which to use for mute buttons, stopping screen sharing, and turning off the camera.
- [Simulcast and resolution](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/video-stream-layers.md): Capture resolution vs. simulcast in the Web SDK: default camera_big / camera_small behavior of the camera presets, how to change high-stream resolution, publish only the high stream, publish a single low-resolution stream, customize simulcasts, and how remote users see layers.
- [Screen sharing](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/screen-sharing.md): Share the screen with the Web SDK: create, capture, preview, and publish a LocalScreenTrack, handle the browser's built-in Stop sharing button via TRACK_ENDED, capture system audio, ScreenCaptureOptions parameters, and the ScreenPresets.
- [Multi-window and dual-screen video layout](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/multi-window-video-layout.md): Show video in separate windows with the Web SDK: pop out a track to its own window for dual-screen layouts, keep a floating camera window via picture-in-picture while sharing the screen, sync UI with TRACK_PIP_* / TRACK_POPOUT_* events, and clean up when sharing ends.
- [Custom tracks](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/custom-track.md): Publish any MediaStreamTrack with the Web SDK: wrap synthesized audio with createLocalCustomAudioTrack, Canvas video with createLocalCustomVideoTrack, mix several audio tracks with createMixedAudioMediaStreamTrack, and stop custom tracks. Read when built-in mic and camera capture isn't enough.
- [Local recording](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/local-recording.md): Record the current user's call view in the browser with LocalCompositeRecorder: composite video tiles you lay out yourself plus mixed audio into one webm file, start options and video item fields, updating the view, pause/resume, chunked upload, state, and cleanup.
- [Audio/video processors (plugins)](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/audio-processor.md): Attach processing plugins such as noise suppression or voice changing to local tracks in the Web SDK through the TrackProcessor interface: setProcessor / removeProcessor, chaining processors with ProcessorPipeline, writing a custom processor, and lifecycle rules.
- [RNN noise suppression plugin](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/rnnoise.md): Enable AI noise suppression on a microphone track with @seastart/srtc-plugin-rnnoise: install, host the three static assets in one directory, attach with setProcessor and basePath, options, and trade-offs vs. the browser's native noiseSuppression.
- [DeepFilterNet noise suppression plugin](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/advanced/deepfilternet.md): Enable AI noise suppression with adjustable strength on a microphone track with @seastart/srtc-plugin-deepfilternet: install, self-host the wasm and model, attach with setProcessor, adjust suppressionLevel or bypass at runtime, and trade-offs vs. the RNNoise plugin.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Web SDK · API reference

- [SRTC](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/api-reference/SRTC.md): API reference for SRTC, the Web SDK's main entry class: constructor, joining and leaving channels, channel and user info, network quality queries, device enumeration, creating local tracks, publishing and subscribing, IM, event callbacks, and destroy.
- [media-tracks](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/web/api-reference/media-tracks.md): API reference for the Web SDK's local and remote track classes: the class hierarchy, BaseTrack metadata, capture and device switching, playback and play views, picture-in-picture and pop-out windows, simulcast sub-tracks, processors, mirroring, and jitter buffer control.

Read after completing integration.
- [Network quality](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/network-quality.md): Monitor network quality in the Android SRTC SDK: quality level changes via onNetworkQualityChanged, periodic onMediaMetric snapshots, on-demand getMetric(), qualityReport levels, and handling poor uplink/downlink and reconnects. Read when building network indicators or poor-network handling.
- [Types](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/types.md): Field reference for Android SRTC SDK data structures: ChannelInfo, UserInfo, TrackInfo, UserTrackDesc, VolumeInfo, ActiveSpeakerInfo, NetworkQualityChange, camera and microphone device capabilities, and YuvFormat constants. Read when you need the values and meaning of an Android SDK enum.
- [Media quality](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/media-quality.md): Field-level data dictionary for Android SRTC media quality statistics in MediaMetric: the overall Metric, server-side uplink/downlink QualityReport, network, upload, and download stats, and per-track audio/video sender and receiver stats. Read when interpreting onMediaMetric data.
- [Error codes](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/error-codes.md): Android SRTC error codes: librtc StatusCode values (100xxx), the SDK's own 102xxx codes by domain (channel, camera, microphone, screen, stream, HTTP), the RtcErrorCatalog lookup API, pass-through rules, and which callbacks to handle. Read when handling or logging Android SDK errors.
- [Changelog](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/changelog.md): Android SRTC SDK release history by version: new features, fixes, improvements, and breaking changes such as the OOK engine removal, multi-channel support, decoupled microphone capture, and camera switching changes. Read before upgrading the Android SDK.

Read when your app controls or displays the output device.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Android SDK · API reference

- [RTCEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCEngine.md): API reference for RTCEngine, the Android SRTC SDK entry point: lifecycle, IM, ASR, joining and leaving channels, listeners, media quality, audio routing, devices, virtual background, getting tracks, publishing, subscription, and info queries. Look up any Engine method here.
- [RTCChannel](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCChannel.md): API reference for RTCChannel, the Android handle for a single channel returned by RTCEngine.join(...): lifecycle, listeners, user and track queries, publishing, subscription, ASR, and media statistics, all isolated per channel. Read when working with multiple channels or per-channel operations.
- [RTCEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCEngineEvent.md): API reference for RTCEngineEvent, the Android global error listener passed to RTCEngine.create(...) that shares the Engine lifecycle: onError parameters and an example. Read to handle blocked operations and errors that don't belong to a single channel's events.
- [LocalCameraTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalCameraTrack.md): API reference for Android LocalCameraTrack: camera capture, preset copy semantics, front/back and device-level camera switching with first-frame success criteria, mirroring, angle offset, flash control, and inherited rendering methods. Read when controlling the local camera.
- [LocalScreenTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalScreenTrack.md): Android screen sharing track API: request screen capture permission, start and stop screen capture, configure the foreground service notification, bind render views, and handle RTCScreenStateEvent. Read when implementing screen sharing on Android.
- [LocalMicTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalMicTrack.md): Android shared microphone capture track: explicitly start and stop capture independently of any channel, read the volume, enumerate and switch input devices, receive local PCM, and publish to one or more channels. Read when working with microphone audio on Android.
- [LocalCustomVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/LocalCustomVideoTrack.md): Android local track for pushing external raw YUV (I420) video frames into a channel, for whiteboards, canvases, players, or third-party sources: the preOpt preset, inputData frame format requirements, publishing flow, and caveats. Read when publishing custom video on Android.
- [RemoteVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RemoteVideoTrack.md): Android remote video track API: bind render views, monitor receive stalls with RTCRemoteVideoEvent, and configure the VcsPlayerGlTextureView / VcsPlayerGlSurfaceView render views (rotation, flip, scale type, updateFrame). Read when displaying remote or local video on Android.
- [RemoteAudioMixTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RemoteAudioMixTrack.md): Android remote mixed audio track API: startPlay and stopPlay turn local playback of remote audio on and off. Read when you need to control whether remote users' audio is played on the device.
- [RTCClientEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCClientEvent.md): Android per-channel control events: join results, user and track changes, channel property updates, in-channel custom messages, disconnects, and reconnection. Every event that belongs to a channel carries the channel ID. Read when handling channel callbacks on Android.
- [RTCMediaEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCMediaEvent.md): Android per-channel media events: media server connection, remote video frames, media metrics, network quality changes, volume reports, and active speakers. Every callback carries the channel ID. Read when handling media callbacks on Android.
- [RTCCameraDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCCameraDeviceEvent.md): Android Engine-global camera device events: camera list changes, physical disconnects, and capture runtime errors, registered with setRtcCameraDeviceEvent. Read when you need to react to camera hot-plugging or camera failures on Android.
- [RTCMicDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCMicDeviceEvent.md): Android Engine-global microphone input device events: input device list changes and invalidation of the device currently capturing, registered with setRtcMicDeviceEvent. Read when you need to react to headset, Bluetooth, or USB microphone plugging on Android.
- [RTCLocalAudioFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCLocalAudioFrameEvent.md): Android callback that delivers local PCM frames from shared microphone capture, for local recording, writing to disk, or app-level audio processing: parameters, threading, and the requirement to start LocalMicTrack capture. Read when you need raw local microphone audio on Android.
- [RTCImEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/RTCImEvent.md): Android event callbacks for the IM channel (out-of-channel messaging): connection success, disconnect, reconnecting, reconnected, and incoming IM messages. Read when handling IM connection state or messages on Android.
- [AudioRouterManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/AudioRouterManager.md): Android API for switching audio output routes between the speaker, earpiece, wired headset, and Bluetooth headset: getting the singleton, auto-switch policies, manual switching, audio focus, device queries, and callbacks. Read when controlling audio output devices on Android.
- [LogUtil](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/api-reference/LogUtil.md): Android SDK logging utility: reuse LogUtil to write leveled logs (v/d/i/w/e) and structured marker, format, and metric logs into the same local log file as the SDK's own logs. Read when you want app logs collected alongside SDK logs for debugging.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Android SDK · Presets

- [Camera preset](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/presets/camera.md): Android camera track preset PreOptionCamera: capture options (CameraCaptureOptions), publish options (VideoPublishOptions), the built-in 1080p/720p/480p/180p presets, and PublishCustomOptions for overriding publish parameters. Read when choosing or tuning camera resolution, frame rate, or bitrate.
- [Microphone preset](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/presets/microphone.md): Android microphone track preset PreOptionMic: capture options (MicCaptureOptions for AEC, noise suppression, AGC, sample rate), publish options (AudioPublishOptions for codec, bitrate, DTX, RED), and the default PreOptionMic.def values. Read when configuring microphone capture or audio publishing.
- [Screen sharing preset](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/presets/screen-sharing.md): Android screen sharing preset PreOptionScreen: capture options (ScreenCaptureOptions), publish options (VideoPublishOptions with TRACK_SHARE), and the default PreOptionScreen.def values. Read when configuring screen sharing resolution, frame rate, or bitrate.
- [Custom video preset](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/android/presets/custom-video.md): Android custom video preset PreOptionCustomVideo for LocalCustomVideoTrack: capture options that describe the external frame source, publish options, and the built-in def (TRACK_CUSTOM) and screen (TRACK_SHARE) presets. Read when publishing external YUV frames on Android.

- [Integration](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/integration.md): Download links for the Windows SRTC C++ SDK (x86 and x64 packages), environment requirements, package layout, Visual Studio project configuration, and which runtime DLLs and plugins to ship. Read before adding the SDK to a Windows desktop project.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/quickstart.md): The minimal Windows SRTC C++ flow: initialize IRTCEngine with log options, create an IRTCChannel, configure it and register callbacks before join(), publish camera/microphone/screen tracks, play remote audio, render remote video, record locally, and leave. Read after completing integration.
- [Types](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/types.md): Structs and JSON for the Windows SRTC C++ SDK: engine options, publishing and capture options, track and user info, device enumeration JSON, custom stream frames, callback JSON (uplink, downlink, audio level, network probe), and the recording layout. Read when filling structs or parsing callbacks.
- [Enums](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/enums.md): Enum values of the Windows SRTC C++ SDK: StreamCodec (AAC, Opus, H.264, H.265), StreamModelEnum media streaming modes, ViewEnumType render types, and LocalRecordStatusEnum local recording states. Read when setting a codec or mode, or handling recording status.
- [Error codes](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/error-codes.md): StatusCode values returned by the Windows SRTC C++ SDK: the common 100xxx codes shared by all platforms and the Windows-specific 101xxx codes, with the enum name and meaning of each. Read when a Windows SDK call returns a non-OK status.
- [Changelog](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/changelog.md): Release history of the Windows SRTC C++ SDK, from rtc2.0 to 0.2.1-alpha.11: new features, changes, fixes, and whether each release changes the API (breaking releases require a recompile, not just a DLL swap). Read before upgrading the SDK.

## [EN] SRTC Audio & Video SDK · Windows SDK · API reference

- [IRTCEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCEngine.md): API reference for IRTCEngine, the process-level object of the Windows SRTC C++ SDK: RTCEngine_Init / RTCEngine_Free, version and error messages, creating and leaving channels, network speed tests, device enumeration, and log upload. Read when setting up the engine or managing channels.
- [IRTCEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCEngineEvent.md): API reference for IRTCEngineEvent, the Windows SRTC engine-level callback interface: network probe results, device plug and unplug, default device changes, and IM connection and message callbacks. Read when handling events that don't belong to any single channel.
- [IRTCChannel](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannel.md): API reference for IRTCChannel, the Windows SRTC per-channel object: the create → configure → join() sequence, settings and event handler, user and channel info queries, local and remote track objects, publishing, and subscribing. Read when working with a channel after createChannel.
- [IRTCChannelEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannelEvent.md): API reference for IRTCChannelEvent, the Windows SRTC per-channel callback interface: join success, channel and user updates, stream add/update/remove, custom messages, uplink/downlink levels and statistics, audio levels, disconnection, reconnection, and recording status. Register it before join().
- [IRTCRecord](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRecord.md): API reference for IRTCRecord, the Windows SRTC local recording object (one per channel): output file name, watermark, output size, recording a window region, the user view layout, and starting, pausing, and stopping recording. Read when implementing local recording.
- [IRTCLocalScreenTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalScreenTrack.md): API reference for IRTCLocalScreenTrack, the Windows SRTC local screen sharing track: update capture options (RTCScreenCaptureOptions) and start or stop screen capture. Read when implementing screen sharing.
- [IRTCLocalCameraTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalCameraTrack.md): API reference for IRTCLocalCameraTrack, the Windows SRTC local camera track: update capture options (RTCCameraCaptureOptions) and start or stop camera capture. Read when publishing camera video.
- [IRTCLocalMicTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalMicTrack.md): API reference for IRTCLocalMicTrack, the Windows SRTC local microphone track: update capture options (RTCMicCaptureOptions) and start or stop microphone capture. Read when publishing microphone audio.
- [IRTCLocalVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalVideoTrack.md): API reference for IRTCLocalVideoTrack, the Windows SRTC base class for local video tracks (camera and screen): add, remove, or clear IRTCView render targets for local preview. Read when showing a local preview.
- [IRTCLocalAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCLocalAudioTrack.md): API reference for IRTCLocalAudioTrack, the Windows SRTC base class for local audio tracks such as IRTCLocalMicTrack. Read to understand the audio track class hierarchy.
- [IRTCRemoteVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRemoteVideoTrack.md): API reference for IRTCRemoteVideoTrack, the Windows SRTC remote video object (a user's video or the composite stream): add, remove, or clear IRTCView render targets. Read when rendering remote video.
- [IRTCRemoteAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCRemoteAudioTrack.md): API reference for IRTCRemoteAudioTrack, the Windows SRTC remote audio mixing object: start audio output to a speaker (RTCAudioOutputOptions) and stop it. Read when playing remote audio.
- [IRTCCustomVideoTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCCustomVideoTrack.md): API reference for IRTCCustomVideoTrack, the Windows SRTC custom video track: push your own encoded video frames (such as H.264 or H.265) with pushVideoFrame. Read when publishing video from a source other than a camera or screen.
- [IRTCCustomAudioTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCCustomAudioTrack.md): API reference for IRTCCustomAudioTrack, the Windows SRTC custom audio track: push your own encoded audio frames (such as AAC or Opus) with pushAudioFrame. Read when publishing audio from a source other than a microphone.
- [IRTCView](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCView.md): API reference for IRTCView, the Windows SRTC virtual base class for render targets: choose HWND rendering (the SDK draws into your window handle) or callback rendering (the SDK hands you YUV frames or a solid RGB fill). Read when rendering local or remote video.
- [IRTCTrack](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCTrack.md): API reference for IRTCTrack, the base class of all Windows SRTC track objects: getTrackInfo returns the track's basic info (ID, desc, kind, codec, resolution, and more). Read to understand the track class hierarchy.
- [IRTCChannelSetting](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/rtc/windows/api-reference/IRTCChannelSetting.md): API reference for IRTCChannelSetting, the Windows SRTC per-channel settings: each item's default value, meaning, and when it takes effect (before join() or at any time while in the channel), plus the set_/get_ accessor pattern. Read before calling join().

These events exist only on the SeaStart (SFU) engine.

Read when built-in capture isn't enough.

- [Overview](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/overview.md): What the SMeeting conferencing SDK (STMLink Meeting) covers, the three integration options from server-side low-code integration to fully custom UI, and supported platforms. - [Choosing SRTC or SMeeting](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/choose.md): How SRTC (audio and video SDK) and SMeeting (conferencing SDK) are layered, how their terms and capabilities differ, and which one fits your product. Read before you start integrating, if you're not sure which layer to build on.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/quickstart.md): The shortest path to integrating SMeeting: who is responsible for what across your client, your backend, our SDK, and our server; how data flows; how to choose among the three integration options; and where to start on each platform.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/key-concepts.md): The SMeeting model: rooms vs. meetings and the meeting lifecycle, built-in roles (host, co-host, regular member), audience, custom roles, the three types of messages, multi-device presence, and how SMeeting terms differ from the underlying SRTC layer.
- [Token and authentication](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/token.md): How SMeeting authentication works: the different roles of AppID and AppKey, how your backend issues the meeting token the client logs in with, what the session covers after login, and a pre-launch secret key security checklist.
- [Error code format](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/error-codes.md): How SMeeting error codes are numbered (prefix plus a 3-digit code), how to tell server, cross-platform SDK, and platform-specific errors apart, and why SRTC 1xxxxx codes show up alongside SMeeting 2xxxxx codes. Read this when troubleshooting an error code.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/ai.md): Connect the SRTC / SMeeting docs to AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor: install the integration skills with one command, or connect the docs MCP server. Also covers llms.txt, per-page Markdown, and how to prompt for better results.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · Android SDK · API reference

- [MeetingEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingEngine.md): The single public entry point of the SMeeting Android SDK: initialization, pre-meeting management, entering and exiting meetings, meeting controls, local media, sharing, messages, remote subscription, cast codes, and virtual background. Look up any MeetingEngine method signature and behavior here.
- [InfosManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/InfosManager.md): Read-only local snapshots of the current meeting, its members, and their SRTC tracks in the SMeeting Android SDK. Read this when you need meeting info, member info, or a track to subscribe to without a network request.
- [RollCallManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/RollCallManager.md): In-meeting roll call manager for the SMeeting Android SDK: start and end roll calls, call and confirm members as the host, answer as a member, and query or export details. Read this when building roll call features.
- [SignInManager](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/SignInManager.md): In-meeting sign-in manager for the SMeeting Android SDK: create and end sign-in activities, sign in as a member, count sign-ins, query records, and export them as a stream. Read this when building sign-in features.
- [Meeting result callbacks](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingResultCallback.md): The contract of MeetingResultCallback and MeetingValueResultCallback<T>: success and failure, callback threads, and error codes. Read this when handling the one-shot result of any asynchronous SMeeting Android API.
- [Meeting events overview](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/meeting-events.md): How SMeeting Android splits ongoing events into Engine, IM, device, room, member, message, media, and raw-frame interfaces, their lifecycles and callback threads, and which interface to register for each need. Read this before registering in-meeting events.
- [MeetingEngineEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingEngineEvent.md): Receive global Meeting Engine runtime errors that can't be attributed to a single call or the current meeting, registered through MeetingEngine.engineEvent. Read this when handling ongoing SDK-level errors.
- [MeetingImEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingImEvent.md): Receive Meeting IM connection, reconnection, raw message, call, meeting reminder, waiting room, and sub-meeting help events, registered through MeetingEngine.imEvent. Read this when you use enableIm() for out-of-meeting messages.
- [MeetingCameraDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingCameraDeviceEvent.md): Receive changes to the process-wide shared camera list, device disconnections, and runtime errors through MeetingEngine.cameraDeviceEvent, before and during the meeting. Read this when you show a camera picker or handle camera failures.
- [MeetingMicDeviceEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMicDeviceEvent.md): Receive changes to the process-wide shared mic input device list and invalidation of the current device through MeetingEngine.micDeviceEvent, before and during the meeting. Read this when you show a mic picker or handle unplugged devices.
- [MeetingScreenCaptureEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingScreenCaptureEvent.md): Receive the Android local screen capture state (MediaProjection / SRTC) through MeetingEngine.screenCaptureEvent. It is not the server-side screen sharing state; read this when you need to clean up sharing UI after capture stops or fails.
- [MeetingRoomEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingRoomEvent.md): Receive the current meeting's room configuration, connection, host, recording, sharing, raise hand, sub-meeting, and sign-in events through MeetingEngine.roomEvent. Read this when you track meeting-wide state or handle disconnects and reconnects.
- [MeetingUserEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingUserEvent.md): Receive the current meeting's member enter/exit, role and permission, device state, request and reply, waiting room, meeting move, and track change events through MeetingEngine.userEvent. Read this when you maintain the member list or decide what to subscribe to.
- [MeetingMessageEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMessageEvent.md): Receive the current meeting's member chat messages, system messages, and app extension messages through MeetingEngine.messageEvent. Read this when you build in-meeting chat or exchange in-meeting custom messages.
- [MeetingMediaEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingMediaEvent.md): Receive the current meeting's media connection, remote raw frames, media statistics, volume, active speaker, and network quality changes through MeetingEngine.mediaEvent. Read this when you show call quality, speaking indicators, or process remote video frames.
- [MeetingLocalVideoFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingLocalVideoFrameEvent.md): Receive local YUV video frames and capture size or camera facing changes through MeetingEngine.localVideoFrameEvent, with or without entering a meeting. Read this when you process or record local camera frames yourself.
- [MeetingLocalAudioFrameEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingLocalAudioFrameEvent.md): Receive local mic PCM frames with their sample rate, channel count, and audio format through MeetingEngine.localAudioFrameEvent, with or without entering a meeting. Read this when you process local mic audio yourself.
- [MeetingRemoteVideoEvent](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/android/api-reference/MeetingRemoteVideoEvent.md): Receive the receive and stutter state of a single remote video, composite stream, or Wangsu video stream, registered through the event parameter of startPlayRemoteVideo(), startPlayRemoteMixture(), or subscribeWsVideoStream(). Read this when you show per-video stutter indicators.

- [ISMeetingChannel meeting API](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-channel.md): Meeting-level C++ API of the SMeeting Windows SDK on ISMeetingChannel: channel ID and settings, setting the event handler before enter(), entering the meeting and exiting the waiting room, room and member info, nickname, chat, custom messages, raise hand, and waiting room management.
- [Host management APIs](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-admin.md): C++ host and co-host APIs of the SMeeting Windows SDK on ISMeetingChannel: end the meeting, room-wide camera, microphone, chat, screenshot, lock, and sharing controls, member name, role, and chat permissions, controlling members' devices, removing members, raise-hand approval, and invites.
- [Sub-meeting APIs](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-submeeting.md): C++ sub-meeting APIs of the SMeeting Windows SDK on ISMeetingChannel: create sub-meetings under a main meeting, rename them, assign and move members, list, start, stop, and delete them, and ask the host for help from inside a sub-meeting.

- [Sign-in APIs](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-signin.md): C++ sign-in APIs of the SMeeting Windows SDK on ISMeetingChannel: list, create, and finish sign-in activities, get statistics and details, sign in as a member, and export sign-in details to a file.
- [Media track APIs](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-media.md): C++ media object APIs of the SMeeting Windows SDK: local microphone, camera, and screen objects, remote audio and video, MCU video, custom tracks, and local recording, plus the IMEETLocalMic, IMEETLocalCamera, IMEETLocalScreen, IMEETRemoteVideo, IMEETRemoteAudio, IMEETRecord, and IMEETVideo methods.
- [Event callbacks](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-events.md): All callbacks of the SMeeting Windows SDK: engine-level ISMeetingEngineEvent (devices, network probe, IM) and meeting-level ISMeetingChannelEvent (connection, members, room state, host controls, media quality, sign-in, recording, sub-meetings), with parameters and when to bind them.
- [Settings](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-settings.md): Setting items of the SMeeting Windows SDK: engine-level ISMeetingSetting (log path, stream log) read at login, and meeting-level ISMeetingChannelSetting with the getter/setter of each item and when it takes effect (at enter() or any time).
- [Enums and data structures](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/windows/api-reference/smeeting-types.md): Enums and structs of the SMeeting Windows SDK C++ API: StatusCode values, DisconnectReason, chat, raise-hand, camera, microphone, sharing, role, device, and network-level enums, plus SMeetingCreateMeetingModel fields with defaults, attachments, resources, and CustomPublishTrack.

Read when users need notifications outside a meeting.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · Swift SDK (iOS/macOS) · API reference

- [SMeetingEngine](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/swift/api-reference/SMeetingEngine.md): API reference for SMeetingEngine, the single entry point of the SMeeting Swift SDK: initialization, properties, login and logout, creating and querying meetings, entering and exiting, state queries, member actions, out-of-meeting messages, and virtual background. Look up signatures and throws here.
- [Media control](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/swift/api-reference/media-control.md): API reference for SMeeting Swift SDK media methods on SMeetingEngine: camera and microphone, screen sharing including the macOS source overload and iOS full-screen broadcast, view capture, remote video and audio subscription and playback, and the MCU composite. Look up parameters and throws here.
- [Devices](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/swift/api-reference/devices.md): SMeeting Swift SDK device API reference: enumerate cameras, microphones, and speakers, switch the microphone, choose the audio output on macOS, control speakerphone and audio routing on iOS, and the related device and routing events. Read when building device selection or audio output controls.
- [Meeting management](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/swift/api-reference/admin-actions.md): SMeeting Swift SDK management API reference: room controls, member management, invitees and devices, waiting room, sub-meetings, layout and recording, resources, and sign-in, plus the shared login / in-meeting preconditions and error rules. Read when implementing host controls.
- [SMeetingRemoteVideoView](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/swift/api-reference/SMeetingRemoteVideoView.md): SMeetingRemoteVideoView, the SwiftUI component that renders a remote member's video and subscribes and unsubscribes automatically as the view appears and disappears: initializer parameters, behavior guarantees, and when to use other entry points instead. Read when rendering remote video in SwiftUI.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · iOS SDK (Objective-C)

- [Quickstart](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/quickstart.md): Get the SMeeting iOS (Objective-C) MeetingKit SDK running: install via CocoaPods, set permissions, log in, create a room, create a MeetingKitRoom instance and enter it, handle room events, turn the camera and microphone on or off, and subscribe to remote video. Read this first.
- [Types](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/types.md): Every model and enum of the iOS SMeeting SDK (Objective-C): meeting and entry parameters, user and room data, chat, member, recording, layout, media config, sign-in, and waiting room models, plus device, role, sharing, exit reason, and quality enums. Read for a field's meaning or an enum value.
- [Error codes](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/error-codes.md): The SEAError enum of the iOS SMeeting SDK (Objective-C): every case with its value and meaning, covering server API errors passed through (1xxx, 2xxx, 10xxx) and SDK system, common, network, and client errors (100xxx, 103xxx). Read when handling or troubleshooting an error code.
- [Changelog](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/changelog.md): Release history of the iOS SMeeting SDK (Objective-C MeetingKit) from 0.0.1-alpha.1 to 2.1.0: new APIs, fixes, and RTCEngineKit dependency upgrades per version, including the 2.0.0 multi-room MeetingKitRoom refactor and the 2.1.0 iOS 16 minimum. Read before upgrading.
- [FAQ](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/faq.md): Common problems when integrating the iOS SMeeting SDK (Objective-C): build failures, network requests failing after network permission is granted, App Store upload failures, and the dyld Library not loaded crash with manual integration. Read when an integration or packaging step fails.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · iOS SDK (Objective-C) · Advanced

- [Screen recording](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/advanced/screen-recording.md): Screen sharing for the SMeeting iOS (Objective-C) SDK: create a Broadcast Upload Extension, add the MeetingKit dependency and background mode, handle screen capture status in MeetingKitRoomDelegate, and start capture and send frames from SampleHandler.
- [Virtual background](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/advanced/virtual-background.md): Virtual background in the SMeeting iOS (Objective-C) SDK: person segmentation for background blur or replacement, no license key needed. Covers why it's a device-level setting, why camera switches and reconnects need no re-apply, and two frame-rate parameters for low-end devices.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · iOS SDK (Objective-C) · API reference

- [MeetingKit](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKit.md): Global singleton of the SMeeting iOS (Objective-C) SDK: login and logout, IM, meeting queries and scheduling, creating and querying room instances, local capture and preview, audio routing, virtual background, and screen capture extension APIs. Read this for account- and device-level APIs.
- [MeetingKitRoom](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitRoom.md): Meeting room instance of the SMeeting iOS (Objective-C) SDK: enter and exit the room, local audio, video, and sharing, chat and raise hand, host controls, cloud recording, waiting room, sub-meetings, sign-in, and room data queries. Read this for all in-meeting APIs.
- [MeetingKitDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitDelegate.md): Global event callback protocol of the iOS SMeeting SDK: audio route changes and app performance, independent of how many rooms you have entered. Read this to handle device-level events; in-room events are in MeetingKitRoomDelegate.
- [MeetingKitRoomDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitRoomDelegate.md): Room event callback protocol of the iOS SMeeting SDK: entering and exiting, room settings and host actions, member state, chat messages, cloud recording, screen sharing, stream quality, and sign-in. Every callback carries the source room instance. Read this when handling in-room events.
- [MeetingKitIMDelegate](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/ios/api-reference/MeetingKitIMDelegate.md): Callback protocol of the iOS SMeeting SDK's out-of-meeting message path (IM): connection state, incoming calls, meeting reminders, being admitted from the waiting room, and sub-meeting help requests. Read this after calling enableImWithDelegate:.

- [Error codes](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/error-codes.md): Values of the code field in server API responses

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · Server API · Guides

- [Cloud recording and live streaming guide](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/guides/recording.md): How cloud recording, stream mixing, and live streaming work for meetings: combining task types, when tasks start automatically, layouts and grid assignment, and how to get recording files and live stream URLs. Read this before integrating meeting recording.
- [Callback events guide](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/guides/callbacks.md): How SMeeting notifies your backend when meetings, members, or recordings change: request format, signature verification, response requirements, the fields of each event, and idempotency. Read this when setting up callbacks.
- [Device integration and IM](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/guides/agent-and-im.md): SMeeting reuses the SRTC device integration and IM endpoints as-is. Explains the two differences when calling them through SMeeting (domain and signing credentials) and why a device's target is the meeting_id, not the room number.

## [EN] SMeeting Conferencing SDK · Server API · API reference

- [Meeting authorization](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/user-auth.md): Issue meeting tokens for users in your system, and force authorized users to log out
- [Meeting management](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/meet.md): Meeting scheduling before and after the meeting: create, update, cancel, and query meetings, plus attendance records and chat history
- [In-meeting controls](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/meet-admin.md): Actions the host can take during a meeting: audio and video controls for everyone, member roles and removal, raise-hand handling, and calling users into the meeting
- [Meeting recording and live streaming](https://docs.stmlink.com/en/meeting/server-api/mcu.md): Cloud recording of the whole meeting, playback URLs, and live streaming
